bibl.title: Ancora su Gallo e Adone.
bibl.seg: Paola Gagliardi, Ancora su Gallo e Adone.
bibl.note: The comparison between Prop. 2, 34, 91-92 and Virg. ecl. 10, 18 allows to argue that Gallus treated Adonis in his love elegy and that he used this character as an exemplum.
